summary: High-risk anomaly: System process name svchost.exe running unsigned from user temporary folder.

observed_facts.text: Binary name svchost.exe located in C:/Users/alice/AppData/Local/Temp/svchost.exe instead of System32.
Signature state is unsigned, violating expected Microsoft Windows signing for system names.
Parent process is interactive explorer.exe rather than services.exe.

hypotheses.text: Masquerading attack attempting to disguise executable as legitimate system service host.

benign_explanations: Unlikely to be benign; potential poorly designed installer or synthetic test fixture.

recommended_actions.reason: Inspect temporary folder and isolate suspicious binary.
Check file SHA-256 against malware intelligence databases.

uncertainty_notes: Definitive system path mismatch and unsigned state strongly indicate masquerading.
